verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch docs show a one-line Docker quickstart for local development/testing and a free serverless trial project, both of which let a user spin up an isolated instance separate from production (elastic-docs-5, elastic-docs-17, elastic-docs-8, elastic-docs-13). However, there is no explicit 'sandbox mode', synthetic test-data seeding, or documented data-isolation guarantee marketed for AI-native testing workflows. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test-environment feature, guidance on isolating test data from production indices, and independent confirmation that local/trial instances are fully safe substitutes for production testing.
